name: remediate-frontend-performance
job: Remediate frontend performance with before and after path metrics: LCP, INP, FPS, bundle KB, long task ms.

inScope: Framing the user path and metric
Measuring baseline with the repo's real tooling
Finding the owning cause and fixing on the owning path
Re-measuring the same path and reporting deltas
outOfScope: Micro-benchmarks that ignore the user path
Claiming production improvement from local-only numbers
Unrelated refactors without a performance link

inputs: Real tooling: profiler, Lighthouse, browser perf, bundle analyzer
outputs: Baseline metrics for the framed path
failureSemantics: Micro-benchmarks that ignore the user path are not proof; local-only improvement is labeled local-only and never claimed as production improvement.

outcome.observable: The framed path re-measures with deltas against baseline using the repo's real tooling, and the run stops when the metric meets the target or only external blockers remain.
